cases.translation: The future glory of the Lord's new temple

cases.sentence: Спроси их, кто из вас еще помнит этот ___ в его прежней славе?
cases.translation: Ask them, who among you still remembers this house in its former glory?
cases.explain: Direct object of 'помнит' (remembers) takes accusative; for masculine inanimate nouns, accusative = nominative.

cases.sentence: Но сейчас ободрись, Зерававель, ведь я с тобой, возвещает ___ Господа
cases.translation: But now be brave, Zerubbabel, for I am with you, says the Lord
cases.explain: The genitive shows possession or source in the phrase 'says the Lord'.

cases.sentence: По завету, который я заключил с вами, когда вы вышли из ___ этого
cases.translation: By the covenant I made with you when you came out of this Egypt
cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from, out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Вскоре я еще раз сотрясу небеса и землю, море и ___ суши
cases.translation: Soon I will shake the heavens and earth again, the sea and dry land
cases.explain: As a parallel to 'sea and' the accusative is used for the direct object after the implied verb 'shake'.

cases.sentence: Серебро и золото мои, возвещает ___ сил
cases.translation: The silver and gold are mine, says the Lord of Armies
cases.explain: Nominative case as the subject of the verb 'are'.

cases.translation: The glory of this house will exceed the glory of the former

cases.sentence: Все, что они делают, и все, что они приносят там, нечисто перед ___ Господа
cases.translation: Everything they do and everything they bring there is unclean before the Lord
cases.explain: The prepositional phrase 'перед лицом' (before/in the face of) takes the instrumental case.

reading.ru: В двадцать первый день седьмого месяца было слово Господа через пророка Агея.
reading.question: When does God speak to Haggai in this chapter?
options: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month
On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month
On the first day of the sixth month
On the fifteenth day of the fourth month
reading.correct: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month
reading.explain: The text states 'В двадцать первый день седьмого месяца было слово Господа' (On the twenty-first day of the seventh month the word of the Lord came).

reading.ru: Кто из вас еще помнит этот дом в его прежней славе? Каким вы видите его сейчас?
reading.question: What does Haggai ask about the contrast between the old and new temple?
options: Who remembers the former glory, and how do they see it now?
Why should they rebuild if it will never be as grand?
Whether the temple will ever be completed
How much it will cost to restore
reading.correct: Who remembers the former glory, and how do they see it now?
reading.explain: Haggai directly asks these two questions to emphasize the contrast between past glory and present state.

reading.ru: Я сотрясу все народы, и их сокровища придут сюда.
reading.question: What does God promise will happen to the nations' treasures?
options: He will shake all nations and their treasures will come here
He will take the temple's treasures
He will preserve the nations' wealth
reading.correct: He will shake all nations and their treasures will come here
reading.explain: The text says 'Я сотрясу все народы, и их сокровища придут сюда' (I will shake all nations and their treasures will come here).

reading.ru: Слава этого дома превзойдет славу прежнего, говорит Господь сил.
reading.question: What does God say about the glory of the new temple?
options: The glory of this house will exceed the former glory
The new temple will be less glorious than the old
The glory will be the same as before
There will be no glory in the new temple
reading.correct: The glory of this house will exceed the former glory
reading.explain: God explicitly states 'Слава этого дома превзойдет славу прежнего' (The glory of this house will exceed the glory of the former).

reading.ru: Так говорит Господь сил. Спроси священников, что говорит закон.
reading.question: What does God command regarding the priests and the law?
options: Ask the priests what the law says
Tell the priests to study the law
The priests should teach the people the law
reading.correct: Ask the priests what the law says
reading.explain: The text directly commands 'Спроси священников, что говорит закон' (Ask the priests what the law says).

reading.ru: Вспомните недавнее прошлое, до того, как камень был положен на камень в храме Господа.
reading.question: What time period does God ask them to remember?
options: Before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the Lord
During the reign of the previous king
reading.correct: Before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the Lord
reading.explain: God says 'Вспомните недавнее прошлое, до того, как камень был положен на камень' (Remember the recent past, before a stone was laid upon a stone).
